item.title: Meta Pauses International Release of Meta Ray-Ban Display Glasses
item.description: Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses seem to be selling too well, as the company announced it’s delaying the international rollout of its first display-clad smart glasses. item.title: Panasonic Ends Collaboration with Shiftall on MeganeX Series VR Headsets
item.description: Shiftall, the Japan-based VR hardware startup, is no longer working with Panasonic on its MeganeX series of thin and light PC VR headsets. Initially acquired by Panasonic in 2018, Shiftall developed a number of devices as the company’s ad hoc internal skunk works, including the first MeganeX PC VR headset, HaritoraX wireless body trackers, FlipVR motion […] The post Panasonic Ends Collaboration with Shiftall on MeganeX Series VR Headsets appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: ‘UNDERDOGS’ PSVR 2 Port Won’t Get Multiplayer Due to Low Player Numbers
item.description: UNDERDOGS (2024) landed on PSVR 2 back in March 2025, making the popular physics-based mech brawler available across all major VR headsets. While the game is slated to get full multiplayer support on Quest and SteamVR, PSVR 2 owners won’t be so lucky. item.title: New Reference Design From Key Manufacturer Shows What to Expect From MR Headsets in 2026
item.description: A Chinese company which mass produces many of the best known headsets in the industry has shared a new compact MR headset reference design which sets expectations for 2026. Goertek is a little-known but massively important player in the XR industry. The company is a key enabler in the production of XR headsets as it […] The post New Reference Design From Key Manufacturer Shows What to Expect From MR Headsets in 2026 appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Meta’s Language Learning App for Quest Combines Mixed Reality and AI
item.description: Meta released an open source language learning app for Quest 3 that combines mixed reality passthrough and AI-powered object recognition. item.title: Meta Waveguide Provider Claims “world’s first” 70° FoV Waveguide
item.description: Lumus, the company that developed the waveguide optic used in Meta’s Ray-Ban Display smart glasses, says it has achieved a 70° field-of-view in a new design revealed this week at CES 2026. This conveniently matches the 70° field-of-view that Meta achieved in its ‘Orion’ prototype, but only with the use of novel materials. The News […] The post Meta Waveguide Provider Claims “world’s first” 70° FoV Waveguide appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Steam Reveals Most Played PC VR Games of 2025
item.description: Steam has unveiled its mega list of the most played PC VR games of 2025. And it looks to be another year of ‘old reliables’, as the top 50 only features a single game released that year. item.title: Google’s Leading AR Glasses Partner XREAL Raises $100M
item.description: XREAL, the Beijing-based AR glasses maker, announced it has raised $100 million in a recent funding round. item.title: Meta Reportedly Laying Off 10 Percent of Reality Labs, Shifting Focus from VR & Horizon Worlds
item.description: Meta is slated to layoff around 10 percent of staff at its Reality Labs XR division, a New York Times report maintains, as the company appears to be shifting focus to AI and smart glasses. item.title: Meta Reportedly Closes Three First-party Studios Behind Some of Its Biggest VR Games
item.description: Against the backdrop of a broader shuffling of its Reality Labs division, Meta is reportedly closing Armature Studio, Twisted Pixel, and Sanzaru Games, three studios that Meta had previously acquired. The studios were behind some of the company’s biggest first-party VR games, including Deadpool VR, Asgard’s Wrath, and the Resident Evil 4 Quest port.
